title: Owner browser check: Live preflight groups with a provider disconnected (RF-136)
acceptance: On production after a deploy that includes #768, in a real browser, Live on a class with tracks linked to a disconnected provider shows one group naming that provider with a count.
The group's Manage connections opens Music connections, and after connecting the group goes away and focus lands on a visible control.
Run without music and the Blocked verdict read as before.
nextAction: Owed by the owner after the next web deploy (the Air). CI uses mock providers, and the PR's screenshots are the component alone with fixture tracks, so the signed-in screen with a real connection has not been seen. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.
